differences.title: 1. QUERY BUILDING
differences.leftDesc: Kysely builds SQL queries programmatically with a type-safe, chainable API that closely mirrors SQL syntax, offering fine-grained control.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM uses a fluent API with method chaining to construct queries, abstracting SQL and often relying on entity definitions.

differences.title: 2. TYPE SAFETY
differences.leftDesc: Kysely enforces type safety at compile time by analyzing query structures against your database schema, preventing type errors early.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM provides type safety primarily through entity classes and runtime checks, with some compile-time benefits from decorators.

differences.title: 3. ABSTRACTION LEVEL
differences.leftDesc: Kysely offers a thin abstraction over SQL, giving developers direct access to SQL capabilities while maintaining type safety.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM provides a higher level of abstraction, mapping database tables to classes (entities) and handling SQL generation.

differences.title: 4. DATABASE ADAPTERS
differences.leftDesc: Kysely supports various database dialects and drivers through community packages, offering adaptability to different SQL databases.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM includes built-in support for major databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite, simplifying setup for common RDBMS.

differences.title: 5. SCHEMA DEFINITION
differences.leftDesc: Kysely defines schemas using TypeScript interfaces or classes, inferring types directly from your application code.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM uses decorators on classes to define entities and their relationships, which are then used to generate SQL.

differences.title: 6. MIGRATIONS
differences.leftDesc: Kysely relies on external tools or manual management for database migrations, focusing purely on query building.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM provides an integrated CLI for generating and running database migrations, streamlining schema evolution.

differences.title: 7. PERFORMANCE FOCUS
differences.leftDesc: Kysely's minimal abstraction often results in highly optimized SQL queries that closely map to raw performance.
differences.rightDesc: TypeORM's comprehensive feature set and entity mapping can introduce some overhead compared to direct SQL or builder patterns.
